facts.text: I am planning a trip to NYC next week.
I need to remember to pack my phone charger.
I feel like I always end up overpacking.
On my last trip to Europe, I packed five different sweaters and only wore two of them.
I have been trying to get better at packing light.
I am preparing for multiple activities, including hiking and work meetings.
I have been struggling with packing my hair dryer and straightening iron.
I have been struggling to pack snacks for the plane.
I always seem to forget to buy snacks before I leave.
When I forget, I am stuck with limited options available at the airport.

keyphrases: forget to buy snacks before leaving
